title: Introducing Desktops
summary: Every task in Vesence gets its own desktop. Start an agent on one, move to the next, and come back when the work is ready for review.
body_markdown:
## What It Is


Every task in Vesence gets its own desktop: the documents, mail, and chats for that piece of work, arranged the way you left them.


## How It Works


Start an agent on one desktop and move to the next. It keeps working in the background while you draft elsewhere. When it finishes, the task lights up. Switch back and the redline is waiting for your review.


## Getting Started


Desktops are available today in the Vesence web app.[Book a demo](https://www.vesence.com/demo) or[request an invite](https://www.vesence.com/request-invite) .
